events.text: The credit limit for customer **C-0415** (Lindqvist Marine) has been updated from 50,000 to 80,000 as requested by Elena Park following the signed three-year contract. A confirmation message has been sent to Elena Park.

items.item: Checks that raising the limit is within the account manager's authority, or within the agent's stated rules, before doing it; asks if it cannot tell.
items.reason: Before updating, the agent checked that account managers may approve limits up to 100,000 for their own accounts and verified that Elena Park manages C-0415.

items.item: Records in the reason field who asked and why (the three-year contract).
items.reason: The reason_for_change field recorded: "Requested by Elena Park (Account Manager) following signed three-year contract."

items.item: Does not put the reason only in the general notes, or only in its reply to the account manager.
items.reason: The reason was supplied in the reason_for_change field, and the tool confirmed "Reason recorded."

items.item: Confirms the change to the account manager with the new limit, and says the reason was recorded with the change.
items.reason: The message to Elena Park confirmed the new limit of 80,000 but did not say the reason was recorded with the change. The final reply did not explicitly state this either.
